title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering for regional failover edge case
author: Priya Anand
description:
Motivation: During a recent regional outage we observed the SLO enforcer entering a short-lived thrashing state where backoff timers and circuit-breaker transitions were applied out-of-order across the regional routing controller and the local enforcer. This caused rapid load-shedding spikes and delayed regional failover, impacting a subset of Dedicated customers. This hotfix reconciles ordering between the global failover coordinator and the per-region SLO enforcer, adds defensive ordering checks, and hardens the backoff state machine to tolerate a small window of concurrent updates.

Changes in this PR: squash commits that repair ordering and add tests, plus one quick fix after review.

Commits: ["fix(slo-enforcer): serialize backoff state transitions via coordinator token (squash)", "test(slo-enforcer): add integration test for concurrent backoff updates", "chore(test): add flakiness guard for regional-failover integration test"]

Files touched (high level): ["svc/slo-enforcer/enforcer.go: serialize state transitions and add reconciliation loop (small diff)", "svc/failover/coordinator.go: attach coordinator token propagation and ack", "svc/slo-enforcer/state_machine_test.go: new integration test for race window", "ops/helm/values-dedicated.yaml: add temporary feature-flag to roll out fix", "pkg/telemetry/metrics.go: add metric slo_enforcer.reconciliations_total"]

Behavioral summary: The enforcer now requires a coordinator token for non-idempotent backoff updates; if token absent we enqueue a reconciliation and apply idempotent adjustments only. The coordinator token is cheap (small UUID) and propagated in the existing routing metadata header; we intentionally keep the fast-path for common cases. This removes a race between coordinator-driven regional failover and local enforcer backoff expiry that previously led to oscillations.

Tests and CI: Added unit and integration tests that simulate overlapping backoff expiry and coordinator-triggered shed events. CI initially hit a flake in the integration harness (timeout on local test cluster), reran the job and it passed. End-to-end SLO smoke test and canary test were run against staging.

Rollout plan: Feature-flagged by default. We will rollout to staging, run 24h canary traffic, then progressively enable in two regions for 48h each before global rollout. Ops will monitor slo_enforcer.reconciliations_total and regional failover latency dashboards.

Related: linear ENG-4521, SRE-204. Linked support ticket SUP-3201 reported the original outage symptoms.

Notes: This is intentionally small and has a rollback path (disable feature flag, revert single-enforcer check).
